title: How Silicon Valley Got Rich. “When Apple went public in 1980, it...
content: How Silicon Valley Got Rich. “When Apple went public in 1980, it created 300 millionaires. When Microsoft did in 1986, 3,000 employees became millionaires. After Google’s IPO in 2004, 1,000 employees held stock worth more than $5 million.”
author: Jason Kottke
